executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import requests,json,hashlib,re
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1'
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert protocol['status']=='REGISTERED_SOURCE_ONLY_BEFORE_NEW_FED_PAGE_READ'
items=[
 ('fed20220504_statement','https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20220504a.htm','20220504_FOMC原声明.html'),
 ('fed20250319_statement','https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20250319a.htm','20250319_FOMC原声明.html')
]
def fetch(item):
 sid,url,name=item; target=out/'sources'/name
 assert not target.exists(), '原件已存在，应读回执而非重复下载'
 start=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(); attempts=[]
 for attempt in range(1,3):
  try:
   r=requests.get(url,timeout=(15,35),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (historical research; limited requests)'})
   attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'http_status':r.status_code,'final_url':r.url})
   if r.status_code in [403,429]: break
   r.raise_for_status()
   assert urlparse(r.url).hostname=='www.federalreserve.gov'
   raw=r.content
   assert b'<html' in raw.lower() and len(raw)>1000
   with target.open('xb') as h: h.write(raw)
   return {'source_id':sid,'url':url,'final_url':r.url,'path':target.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'started_at':start,'received_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'content_type':r.headers.get('Content-Type'),'attempts':attempts,'status':'DOWNLOADED_ORIGINAL_HTML','historic_receipt':False}
  except Exception as e:
   attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)[:220]})
 return {'source_id':sid,'url':url,'started_at':start,'attempts':attempts,'status':'FAILED_FIXED_SOURCE_REQUEST'}
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 receipts=list(pool.map(fetch,items))
with (out/'source_receipts_stage1.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h: json.dump(receipts,h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); h.write('\n')
for r in receipts: print('原件：'+r['source_id']+'；'+r['status']+'；'+str(r.get('bytes',0))+'字节')
assert all(r['status']=='DOWNLOADED_ORIGINAL_HTML' for r in receipts), '固定原件未齐，来源阶段不能继续推定完整'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
soup=BeautifulSoup((out/'sources/20220504_FOMC原声明.html').read_bytes(),'html.parser')
links=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'href':a.get('href')} for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True) if '20220504' in a['href'] or 'Balance Sheet' in a.get_text(' ',strip=True)]
with (out/'20220504原声明直接链接.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h: json.dump(links,h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); h.write('\n')
print('2022声明直接链接：'+json.dumps(links,ensure_ascii=False))
